character: the mountain itself, old and sullen: it does not crumble, it SPLITS along its strata into big angular plates with clean fresh faces paler than its weathered skin, and puffs its own dust

strips.layout: column = variant v, row = pair p = ia * 4 + ib (ia, ib = the level index of the start / end vertex)

stages.use: opaque overlay over the cell art at stage = dmg/thr crossing 25 / 50 / 75 %; variant h32(x, y, 71) % 4; clip to the rock body

bites.use: one per bullet hit on rock, variant h32(x, y, 80 + salt) % 6, at the hit point; opaque, clipped to the body

facets.#ff0000: top: the art one ramp step lighter
facets.#00ff00: front: the art as it is

chunks.use: as concrete: a removed cell gives 3-6 chunks cut from its own art, turned by 90s, settling on a 36 deg cone with a 1 px contact shadow

facets.#00ff00: the rock's painted face kept AS IT IS
facets.#ff0000: the broken top edge: FRESH rock, lit

slabs.use: as concrete slabs (holes of 3+ cells, min(4, 1 + n // 2)), settled on the hole lower lip inside a mass

behind: deeper rock: the level back plane two steps darker with a contact shadow (as concrete), never a black void
dust: use the game's material dust (dust_impact_mat / dust_puff_mat) in the rock surface colours; a blast hole adds 2-3 smoke_linger puffs tinted #8f6c48
